title: [v0.91.8][WP-21] Implement v0.92 capability envelope (#4761)
body:
Closes #4761

Implements the pre-v0.92 capability envelope as a retained evidence packet for birthday/MVP capability claims. The envelope names provider, model, tool, skill, authority, and limit context; records accepted-product inputs; and preserves explicit non-claims for unsupported runtime, deployment, governance, and production-authority surfaces.

Integrates the envelope into the v0.91.8 feature proof coverage table and the v0.92 demo/memory-grounding consumer surfaces without claiming birthday execution completion.
